title: Nice experience!
text: Excellent experience, the guide Petra was nice and had a bright voice. Really appreciated the winery tour and the sherry from Cayetano del Pino. Beautiful Cadiz, the cathedral is worth visiting, and the beach with the old pier and the lighthouse is also worth it. I also recommend this tour.
author: albertononno

title: I loved Cadiz and it was a bonus to have such an interesting and knowledgeable guide.
text: Pablo was such an interesting guide and we covered all sorts of topics about life in the region from football to agriculture on our drive!  Cadiz was a delightful place just to wander about through the streets and along the beach.  The weather was not all that good and we hit our lunch stop just as the rain poured down.  This was a great experience as I was introduced to local dishes that I would never have tried on my own.  It was nice to have the flexibility to cut short our trip to Jerez as the weather was awful and I have been before.  I really appreciated that Pablo gave his time to help
author: dianalC9596OA

title: Driver Alex was punctual, friendly...
text: Driver Alex was punctual, friendly and great fun. Guide Jesus in Cadiz was equally nice and confident in his tour information. Bit of confusion about where we were to visit in Jerez so we just took a stroll around downtown, very pleasant day overall
author: mella M
